comment: The note line of a published build: shown in builds/index.json, builds/index.html and (when the page already has a note banner) at the top of builds/<tag>/. tools/linux/builds-index.py applies it on every index rewrite. Changing a note line is the only change allowed to a published builds/ page (SPEC 17.11).

tabby-v04.3.text: Never released; superseded by tabby-v04.4. (An earlier note called it faulty; that was a measuring error.)

tabby-v04.5.text: Use tabby-v04.5.1 or later; this page cannot write v3 clips.

tabby-v04.10.text: Use tabby-v04.11.2 or later; on this page Full backup stops on a song that has a scene stored on the panel.

tabby-v04.11.text: Use tabby-v04.11.2 or later; on this page Full backup stops on a song that has a scene stored on the panel.

tabby-v04.11.1.text: Use tabby-v04.11.2 or later; on this page Full backup stops on a song that has a scene stored on the panel.

tabby-v04.15-rc1.text: Not promoted: device tests failed through errors in the test tools, not in the firmware (docs/BUILD.md 51.1, 51.2). The same firmware passed as tabby-v04.15-rc3.

tabby-v04.15-rc2.text: Not promoted: device tests failed through errors in the test tools, not in the firmware (docs/BUILD.md 51.2). The same firmware passed as tabby-v04.15-rc3.

tabby-v04.23-rc1.text: Not promoted: four device tests failed in the measuring (the test computer's clock was being corrected during the run, and one new check could not be aimed by remote). The firmware is the same build as tabby-v04.23-rc2.

tabby-v04.21-rc1.text: Not promoted: one device test failed through an error in the test tool (it pressed the wrong key). The firmware is the same build as tabby-v04.21-rc2.

tabby-v04.18-rc1.text: Not promoted: one timing check of the device tests read 4.21 ms against a limit of 4.0 ms that the test tool had set too tight (docs/BUILD.md 54.3). The same firmware passed as tabby-v04.18-rc2.
